mapper.sql: SELECT pp.id, pp.project_id AS projectId, p.project_name AS projectName, pp.quantity, pp.before_quantity AS beforeQuantity, pp.after_quantity AS afterQuantity, pp.operator_id AS operatorId, pp.operator_name AS operatorName, pp.remark, pp.operation_time AS operationTime, pp.create_time AS createTime FROM production_progress pp LEFT JOIN production_project p ON pp.project_id = p.id
mapper.select: WHERE pp.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY pp.operation_time DESC
